{{Quote|You don't want the Imps ripping into your family. Not a pretty thing when that happens.|[[Isplourrdacartha Estillo|Plourr Ilo]]|<ref name="XWRS27" />}}
The '''Mission to Corellia''' was undertaken by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to evacuate members of the [[Fel dynasty|Fel family]] threatened by the defection of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] hero [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and to rescue the young [[Fyric Fel]], kidnapped before their arrival by [[Ilir Post]].

==Prelude==
Following his capture in the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] Soontir Fel agreed to defect to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] under the condition that they aid him in his search for his now-fugitive wife, [[Syal Antilles Fel]].<ref name="XWRS25" /> To that end, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of Rogue Squadron, brother of Antilles Fel, selected [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo|Plourr Illo]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] for a clandestine mission to make contact with the Fel family on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] under the pretext of leave.<ref name="XWRS26" />

==The mission==
After landing in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the Rogues traveled by [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] to the [[Fel estate]], where they discovered that Fyric Fel, Soontir Fel's two-year-old nephew had been kidnapped that morning. Using Wedge's name as a codeword, they established their presence to [[Todr Fel]], Fyric's father, and avoided being taken into [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] custody by Imperial liaison [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Kirtan Loor]] due to the interference of Officers [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]].<ref name="XWRS26" />

Back at their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the pilots discussed Soontir Fel's loyalties before the arrival of [[Ajai Fel]], Fyric's mother, who revealed that her son's kidnappers hoped to exchange him for Syal Antilles Fel's whereabouts. Fel gave the group the kidnapper's meeting place and a [[holograph]] in the boy's likeness, which, unbeknownst to the Rogues, contained a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] as part of a ploy by the Fel family to use the pilots to draw out the kidnappers. Upon meeting Ilir Post, Fyric's kidnapper who bore a grudge against Soontir Fel for turning him over to CorSec, Plourr Illo attempted to negotiate for the child's safe return. However, recognizing her as the [[Princess of the Realm|Princess]] of [[Eiattu 6]], Post captured her and her allies with the intention of ransoming Illo to her people.<ref name="XWRS26" /> Nevertheless, they were soon interrupted by the arrival of Officers Horn and Wessiri. Post escaped in the chase that followed, while the Rogues explained Soontir Fel's defection to the CorSec officers, and enlisted their support for a rescue attempt on Fyric Fel and Post's location.<ref name="XWRS27">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 27|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 27]]</ref>

The combined force moved in towards the building in which Fel was being held, dispatching the guards before being stopped by Post, holding the child at blasterpoint over a balcony. Before the group could react, Todr Fel, having followed the tracked holograph to their location, shot Illir Post, gambling with his son's life as Fyric fell from Post's arms towards the ground. Diving to his rescue, Illo caught the child before he was harmed. With his son safe, Todr Fel revealed his gambit and agreed to leave with his wife and child under the protection of the New Republic.<ref name="XWRS27" />

As the Rogues' freighter departed with the Fels on board, their escape was cut off by a group of Imperial-aligned [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] flying [[TYE-wing]] [[Ugly/Legends|uglies]]. The outdated freighter struggled to evade the [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]] until Officer Horn once again came to the Rogues' rescue, taking out three of the pirate fighters in his CorSec [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and lining up the fourth to be shot down by Plourr Illo. Now free to go, the group thanked Horn for his assistance, and contemplated the CorSec pilot's suitability to be a Rogue himself.<ref name="XWRS27" />

==Aftermath==
Two years later, in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Corran Horn would join the New Republic and the reformed Rogue Squadron, under now-[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wedge Antilles, who would go on to marry Horn's ex-partner Iella Wessiri.<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="XW:SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

Eventually, Syal Antilles Fel would be reunited with her husband, first alongside her brother in the New Republic, and later, with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Empire of the Hand]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGtC" />
